speaker: abel_garnish
text: The old Hamlet. The book is the company's book, and it is older than your king. Flour is in the dish. A handful, not a bag.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A handful. I will look like a man who slept in a bakehouse, and that is the point of a ghost.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: You enter when I have finished the line I am about to murder. I will murder it twice. Be ready both times.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Is the flour for the hair only, or for the face?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hair, Nick. The face can be a man's. Breathe before you speak. Your voice is sound. Use it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have four lines, and I know them. I will not shout them at a ghost.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Four lines, and they are in the book. Say the book. We are not writing a new ghost this morning.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: First turn. I am the man who sees him. I will not be noble about it. Cue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am come out of the dark of this house. Hear me, and do not touch me.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: That is not the end of my line. You came in on my breath.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then give me the end of the breath, Tom, not the middle. Again.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Second turn. Flour now. A handful. Keep it out of the eyes, or you will play him weeping, and the book does not ask for tears.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: It is in your ear as well.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the ear. The dead are not tidy. Say your four, Nick, and not a fifth.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Four, about a grave that will not stay shut. I will say the four. I will not say them louder than the book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Good. You did not add. Will, you were late on the second turn by a word, and the word was mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Yours, then. I will wait the word. The flour is the entrance. I do not need a louder one.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two turns. The second is the one we keep. You wait the word. Nick's four stay four. Nobody writes in this book today.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can keep a word. I cannot keep a ghost that starts my line for me. Once more, the end of it only.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The end of it. I wait. I come. I do not touch.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And I do not shout. The voice is there without the shout.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then we are done with the door. The afternoon is the play, not this. Wash nothing yet. The flour is the part.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: If the afternoon goes as the second turn went, I will not apologise. I kept my word.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And I kept four. I can do them with the house full, if the flour stays out of my mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The flour stays till the play has had it. A handful, two turns, four lines. I have the morning.
